requiredCases.title: Customer package identity
requiredCases.requirement: Install the exact extracted candidate with the manager; match environment, installed hashes and ownership.

requiredCases.title: Standard-mode control
requiredCases.requirement: Fresh named Standard save keeps the ordinary start and does not mutate trader routing.

requiredCases.title: Navezgane placed-world landing
requiredCases.requirement: Fresh Random Navezgane save lands safely at an approved placed prefab, with matching dynamic identity.

requiredCases.title: Random Gen placed-world landing
requiredCases.requirement: Fresh Random save on a generated world of at least 8K lands safely at an approved placed prefab, with matching dynamic identity.

requiredCases.title: Placed trader route
requiredCases.requirement: From a fresh landing, follow the marker to the logged real placed trader, in the final biome or the recorded cross-biome fallback.

requiredCases.title: Intro and ordinary work
requiredCases.requirement: Finish or retry the intro with the real trader and accept ordinary Tier 1 work.

requiredCases.title: One-shot reload
requiredCases.requirement: After a fresh-process Continue, preserve the landing and quest without another HRS placement.

requiredCases.title: Arrival protection boundary
requiredCases.requirement: Compare protection off/on, protected reload, and a later biome hazard with disposable saves.

requiredCases.title: Owned removal
requiredCases.requirement: Remove only HRS-owned files while preserving saves, settings and unrelated mods.

requiredCases.title: Owned upgrade
requiredCases.requirement: Upgrade an owned prior installation and verify exact candidate hashes and preserved user state.

requiredCases.title: Manager identity rejection
requiredCases.requirement: A disposable altered package and unknown install footprint are rejected without overwriting game files.

requiredCases.title: Exact Game Name guard
requiredCases.requirement: Starting a different fresh Game Name leaves a safe vanilla start with no HRS placement.

Record the eligible set, draw and safe arrival in one distinct run; if no suitable world is available, record Blocked.
